# Social Security Secure Portal (secure.ssa.gov)

> > The official Social Security secure portal for authenticated account access, identity verification, and account management services.

secure.ssa.gov is the Social Security Administration's secure online portal providing citizens with authenticated access to their Social Security accounts. The platform prioritizes identity verification and privacy protection through trusted authentication partners.

## Key Topics

- Social Security
- Login.gov
- ID.me
- Authentication
- Identity Verification
- Sign-in
- Account Creation
- Privacy Act Statement
- Terms of Service
- Account Help
- Login Options
- OMB No. 0960-0789

## Account Access & Authentication

- [Social Security Secure Sign-In](https://secure.ssa.gov/RIL/SiView.action): Social Security account sign-in with Login.gov and ID.me authentication options for secure identity verification
